# Required status checks on `develop` (GitHub branch protection).
#
# These are CHECK-RUN names, not workflow names — you cannot require "ci.yml".
# For a job that calls a reusable workflow the name is "<caller job name> / <job
# id inside the reusable>"; for an inline job it is just the job's `name:`.
#
# ⚠️ RENAMING A JOB HERE BREAKS EVERY PR. Branch protection matches on the exact
# string; the old context simply never reports again, so PRs sit forever on
# "Expected — waiting for status" with nothing explaining why. That is why
# scripts/ci/test-changed-modules.py asserts every name below still exists in
# ci.yml — rename a job and CI fails loudly instead of merges hanging silently.
#
# Only UNCONDITIONAL jobs belong here. Module lanes are gated on the router and
# report "skipped" when their module did not change; GitHub does treat a skipped
# check as satisfied, but requiring them couples branch protection to routing for
# no gain — a lane that must run already runs.
#
# To change the set: edit this file, run the test, then re-apply protection with
#   scripts/ci/apply-branch-protection.sh develop

backend (go build + vet) / verify
frontend-admin (type-check) / typecheck
frontend-web (regression + money + contract + tsc + lint) / verify
hygiene (client secrets + live-DB test gate + migration versions)
migrations (additive-only guard) / guard
mobile (whole-app tsc) / typecheck
openapi (validate all contracts) / validate
which modules changed
workflows (actionlint)
